Everyone wants to know how Fable 5.1 actually stacks up.

Same prompts. Different models. Wildly different results.

Here’s what 5 tests found.

1. Same floor plans, very different processing time

Someone gave Fable 5.1 and GPT-5.6 Sol the same floor plan and asked for a full walkthrough video. Sol wrapped in 30 minutes with 6 images. Fable took nearly four times as long, 111 minutes, and produced 14.

2. Same prompt, two different outputs

Fable 5.1 vs GPT Astra, on a build Astra had not finalized yet. Fable used 78k tokens while Astra got away with 28k.

3. The $5.69 mansion vs The $0.88 mansion

Fable 5.1 vs GPT-5.6 Sol, same mansion brief. Fable ran up to $5.69 and packed in the detail. Sol stayed cheap at $0.88 but came out plainer.

4. Same rocket, two different price tags

Fable 5.1 vs Kimi K3, same rocket prompt. Kimi wrapped in 10 minutes for $6.95. Fable took almost twice as long and nearly double the cost, 18 minutes and $12.60.

5. The rematch Fable actually won

Fable 5.1 vs Kimi K3, rebuilding the same game. Fable pulled ahead on polish and smoother mechanics, but Kimi barely trailed behind with fewer jitters, for less money.

A good prompt still has to survive getting run through a different model. 30 prompting principles that hold up no matter which model you point them at, free:
